responsibility: Implements decomposition of types into the components relevant to outlives reasoning, turning a type-level outlives requirement like `T: 'a` into the regions, parameters, placeholders, aliases, or unresolved inference variables that must themselves outlive the target region. It also handles the special treatment of alias types, including conservative fallback for escaping-bound-variable cases, so region checking and implied-bounds logic can reason about outlives constraints structurally.
